name: Mitch
message: To My Family. You are my greatest blessing. Life feels complete because I have you both by my side. To my wife—you are the heart of our home, the one who gives love and warmth to everything we do. To my son—you are our joy, our light, and the reason our days are filled with laughter and meaning.

name: Babe
message:
From the moment I met you, my life changed in ways I never thought possible. You’ve been my best friend, my partner, my greatest source of strength and joy. With you, I’ve learned what love truly means — not just in the big moments, but in the everyday laughter, the comfort of your presence, and the way you make even the hardest days feel lighter.
I can’t imagine my future without you. I want to spend my life building dreams with you, supporting you, and growing old together — hand in hand, side by side. You are my everything, and I am so grateful to have you by my side through all of life’s adventures. Here’s to us, to our love, and to the beautiful journey ahead.
captions: Our first date - You are so beautiful. I couldn't stop staring.
The proposal - My hands were shaking. You said yes.
Celebrating together - The moment you said 'YES!' changed everything.
Our announcement - Telling the world about our little miracle.
The restaurant setup - I had them write 'Will you marry me?' on the plate.
Forever together - This is what love looks like.
